questions.stem_text: According to Rawls, the two parts of his theory:

options.A: can be proven false with logical reasoning.
options.B: are independent: You can accept either part without accepting the other.
options.C: are based purely on empirical evidence.
options.D: are not open to debate or disagreement.
options.E: cannot be justified via rational means.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - are independent: You can accept either part without accepting the other.
